visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a blue and white vertical striped button-down shirt stands before a dark wall decorated with white geometric triangular patterns. She looks directly into the camera, gesturing with her right index finger while speaking animatedly. Bright studio lighting illuminates her face and upper body, and small decorative items are visible on a side shelf. (2) The scene transitions to a series of close-up shots showing vibrant green matcha powder being scooped with a wooden tool and fine powder being sifted through a mesh. A brief outdoor scene features a woman drinking from a black cup against a lush green mountain forest backdrop, followed by a close-up of a cup of matcha latte with a cat face foam design. (3) The creator reappears in the studio, using both hands to gesture while explaining facts about tea production. A bamboo whisk is shown stirring tea in a ceramic bowl to create foam, and a glass of iced matcha latte is stirred with a metal spoon, showcasing the layered green and white liquid. (4) In the final phase, the woman continues her explanation with high energy and varied hand gestures against the same geometric background. She concludes her message by pointing both index fingers toward the camera, inviting viewer engagement as large, colorful text overlays appear and disappear at the bottom of the frame.
